Name: Loafs More Cats
Author: mintcat3
Description:
Inspired by the original vanilla artstyle, but with more color variety!
Additionally, the cats no longer have a collar, and they LOAF WHEN THEY SLEEP!!

There are options to change out the original 5 cats to a new color, or even orange to gray etc. A False option also exists for the vanilla cat skin.
Colors:
- orange, gray, yellow, white, black (vanilla but muted colors, collars, and loafs)
- brownTabby
- blackTux (tuxedo cat)
- shorthair (white with yellow eyes)
- persian (fluffy white persian with blue eyes)

More colors coming soon; AT is being considered!
Cat color requests are welcome but not guaranteed.
